# prime-drawer

prime-rs: Drawer component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/drawer) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-drawer) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/drawer.md)

Drawer - port of PrimeNG 21.1.10 `p-drawer`.

A panel at the screen edge over the page: mask, enter and leave animations, closing by mask, button and `Escape`,
page scroll blocking and a focus trap. The panel and mask are rendered into `body`.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_drawer::{Drawer, DrawerPosition};

let visible = RwSignal::new(false);
let html = view! {
    <Drawer visible=visible header="Left Drawer" position=DrawerPosition::Left>
        <p>"Body"</p>
    </Drawer>
}
.to_html();
// while the panel is not shown, it is absent from the markup
assert!(!html.contains("p-drawer") && !html.contains("Body"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-drawer = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["drawer"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
